About · Results

Ideas to action. Action to impact.

GPS turns vision into research, research into policy and partnerships, and partnerships into action that improves lives and strengthens societies. This page grows as the evidence does.

85%

of humanity lives in the Global South — yet sets too little of the agenda

120+

institutions and networks designed to plug into one another

6

regional hubs, extensible by design

400+

participants expected in Kigali, October 2027

How we measure

KPIs that mean what they say: Knowledge, Policy, Impact.

Knowledge indicators

What the South produces

Publications and working papers · fellowships awarded · researchers in the network · joint research consortia · academic mobility agreements.

Policy indicators

What decisions change

Policy briefs taken up · advisory engagements with ministries and cities · university–government dialogues institutionalized · frameworks influenced.

Impact indicators

What changes on the ground

Pilots implemented · ventures accelerated · people trained · communities engaged · resources mobilized toward Southern priorities.

⟡

The GPS Impact Observatory — launching by 2029 — will publish these indicators openly, with monitoring, evaluation, and policy-tracking frameworks. Preview the Observatory

2026 · Founding year

Early outcomes

GPS is in its foundation year. These are the milestones already behind us — reported plainly, with no inflation.

Institution

Founding documents adopted

Context & rationale, governance model, five-year strategic framework, and the KPI operating philosophy — adopted May 2026.

Convening

Kigali 2027 in motion

Concept note issued and partnership development underway with GCUB for the General Assembly and Knowledge Crossroads Week.

Platform

Digital launch

This platform — the public face of GPS — with the network, knowledge hub, and engagement architecture live from day one.

Dialogue

GPS Dialogues series

Virtual and regional conversations launching through 2026 — education transformation, AI & governance, indigenous knowledge systems. Join one
